card: Removes unused functions, parameters, struct fields, and dead code across 27 files in 22 targeted commits. The cleanups eliminate dead logic and write-only state in preparation for enabling compiler warning flags like -Wunused (#36167). No functional behavior changes are intended.
changed_since_previous: None; identical commit series to previous review with the full diff now available.
evidence: PR description links to open PR #36167: 'Also generally related to #36167' (build: Enable `-Wunused`).
problem: Unused definitions, write-only state, and unnecessary parameters add clutter, confuse readers, and produce compiler warnings when stricter flags such as `-Wunused` are enabled.

risk.why: Incorrectly identifying active code as dead could break serialization, RPC output, or wallet loading, but every change is an isolated removal of demonstrably unused symbols.

scope_notes: Split into 22 separate commits touching 27 files across different modules (wallet, Qt, serialization, net, and tests).
summary: Removes unused functions, parameters, struct members, and aliases across the codebase across 22 isolated commits. The cleanups span wallet, serialization, net, RPC, GUI, and utility modules without changing runtime behavior. This simplifies maintenance and reduces warnings as part of the broader effort to enable `-Wunused`.
